title: Object hits: events, per-object sounds, chips and leaves, crack progress on objects
player_outcome: Chopping a tree thunks and sheds wood chips and leaves on every hit. Pots shatter with their own sound, glass tinkles, stone furniture cracks. The cursor shows cracks on objects as they take damage. Every tool swing whooshes once per swing.
design: Verified: HitObject returns Damaged silently (WorldEditor.Objects.cs:64-65). ObjectBroken always plays break_wood (SoundEvents.cs:129). The object cursor draws a neutral box (TargetHighlight.cs:64-65).
WorldEditor.Objects: event ObjectHit(TileObjectInstance, ObjectHitResult), raised for Damaged, Broken and TooWeak.
TileObjectDef: Sound (default 'wood'), DustColor (hex, optional), Leaves (hex, optional; trees), Topple (bool; used by P3-22). Validate colours.
New game/Audio/SoundEvents.World.cs, ObjectHit: Damaged → dig_{Sound} (fallback dig_wood); Broken → break_{Sound} (pots use 'pot_shatter'); TooWeak → 'tink'. This replaces the hard-coded break_wood.
Tool whoosh: play 'swing' at −6 dB when the local UseSerial changes and the item is a tool (fixes P3-01's per-hit Used).
BlockEffects (EffectKit): object chips from the object's bounds centre in DustColor (5 on hit, 20 on break). Trees also emit Leaves (8 on hit, 30 on break).
TargetHighlight: for objects in reach, draw faces with progress 1 − HitPoints/Def.HitPoints (the existing crack uniform).
files_modify: game/Audio/SoundEvents.cs — remove break_wood lambda; tool whoosh
data_changes: Trees (oak/pine/palm/mahogany/ebonwood): sound wood, dustColor bark hex, leaves hex, topple true
Pots: sound pot, dustColor #b0603a; glass items: sound glass
Stone furniture/stations: sound stone; plants/decor: sound grass
tests: ItemUseTests.AxeChopsTreesIntoWood (extended): ObjectHit Damaged raised HitPoints−1 times, then Broken
WorldInteractionTests: a hammer on an altar before hardmode raises ObjectHit TooWeak
Smoke basic.cmds: 'place oak_tree 3 0 0' / 'wield copper_axe' / 'aim 0.9 0.2 0' / 'hold use_primary 4' / 'wait 1' / 'assert inv.wood > 0'
verification: Lavapipe: chopping shows chips and leaves; the pot shatters with loot
risks: 'place' of natural objects must be allowed by the command (check EditCommands); otherwise use a world tree via 'tp surface'.
New sound ids fall back to existing ones until P3-27 lands.
